title: Micron forecasts first-quarter revenue well above estimates on AI memory boom
body: Micron Technology posted fiscal fourth-quarter adjusted EPS of $3.42 versus the $3.05 analysts expected and guided first-quarter revenue to $14.2 billion, plus or minus $300 million, against a consensus of $13.1 billion, citing sold-out high-bandwidth memory supply through 2027.
note: Clear EPS beat plus a guide far above consensus is bullish; 'AI' is a generic term, not C3.ai.

title: Nike revenue misses, sportswear maker scraps full-year outlook
body: Nike reported fiscal first-quarter revenue of $11.1 billion, short of the $11.5 billion consensus, and EPS of $0.41 versus $0.49 expected; the company withdrew its fiscal 2027 guidance, pointing to tariff costs and a sharper-than-expected slowdown in Greater China.
note: Revenue and EPS misses combined with a withdrawn outlook are bearish.

title: Delta raises December-quarter profit forecast on record premium bookings
body: Delta Air Lines now sees fourth-quarter adjusted EPS of $1.85 to $2.05, up from a prior range of $1.60 to $1.90, as corporate travel and premium-cabin demand run ahead of plan.
note: A raised profit forecast in the middle of the quarter is bullish for the airline.

title: Cisco to Acquire Nutanix for $82.00 Per Share in Cash
body: SAN JOSE, Calif., Oct. 8, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Cisco Systems, Inc. (NASDAQ: CSCO) and Nutanix, Inc. (NASDAQ: NTNX) today announced a definitive agreement under which Cisco will acquire Nutanix for $82.00 per share in cash, a premium of approximately 31% to Nutanix's last closing price, for a total enterprise value of about $22 billion.
note: The target jumps toward the 31% premium cash price, while a deal under a tenth of Cisco's value is roughly neutral for the buyer.

title: Morgan Stanley upgrades Chipotle to overweight, says traffic has bottomed
body: The brokerage raised its price target on Chipotle Mexican Grill to $62 from $48, saying new menu items and faster kitchen equipment rollouts should return comparable transactions to growth in 2027.
note: The upgrade is bullish for Chipotle; Morgan Stanley is only the broker, and 'price target' is not Target Corp.

title: Barclays cuts Rivian to underweight, flags R2 launch costs
body: Analysts at Barclays lowered their target on Rivian Automotive to $9 from $14, warning that reservation-to-order conversion for the cheaper R2 SUV is tracking below plan while launch spending is running higher.
note: A downgrade to underweight with a much lower target is bearish for Rivian; Barclays is only the source.

title: FDA approves Vertex's islet cell therapy for hard-to-control type 1 diabetes
body: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration cleared Vertex Pharmaceuticals' zimislecel for adults with type 1 diabetes and severe hypoglycemia, with a label broader than many analysts had modeled and no boxed warning.
note: An approval with a broader-than-expected label and no boxed warning is bullish.

title: Biogen and Ionis scrap tau drug after mid-stage Alzheimer's trial fails
body: The antisense therapy BIIB080 did not slow cognitive or functional decline compared with placebo at 76 weeks in the Phase 2 CELIA study, the partners said on Wednesday, and Biogen will end development of the program.
note: The partnered drug failed and was discontinued, which is bearish for both the developer and the originator.

title: Rigetti Computing Enters Into $350 Million At-the-Market Equity Offering Program
body: BERKELEY, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Rigetti Computing, Inc. (Nasdaq: RGTI) today announced that it has entered into an equity distribution agreement under which it may offer and sell shares of its common stock having an aggregate offering price of up to $350 million from time to time.
note: A large at-the-market share sale is dilutive, which is bearish.

title: Booking Holdings adds $20 billion to buyback and lifts dividend 8%
body: The online travel company's board approved the new repurchase authorization, equal to roughly 11% of its market value, on top of about $4 billion remaining under the prior program.
note: A buyback worth about 11% of market value plus a dividend increase is bullish.

title: Realty Income Declares 676th Consecutive Common Stock Monthly Dividend
body: SAN DIEGO, Oct. 8, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Realty Income Corporation (NYSE: O), The Monthly Dividend Company, today announced that its board of directors declared a monthly cash dividend of $0.2700 per share, unchanged from the prior month, payable Nov. 13, 2026.
note: An unchanged, routine monthly dividend is expected and is not news.

title: Philadelphia jury orders J&J to pay $1.4 billion over talc cancer claims
body: The verdict, one of the largest yet against Johnson & Johnson in the baby powder litigation, includes $1.1 billion in punitive damages; the company said it would appeal.
note: A large adverse jury verdict in mass-tort litigation is bearish, even with an appeal planned.

title: EU orders Alphabet to sell Google's AdX exchange in first Big Tech breakup
body: The European Commission said Google must divest its AdX ad exchange within 18 months after concluding that behavioural remedies proposed by Alphabet would not end its conflicts of interest in online advertising technology.
note: A forced divestiture sets a negative regulatory precedent for Alphabet, which affects both share classes.

title: Palantir wins $1.3 billion Army deal to expand Maven Smart System
body: The five-year contract modification raises the ceiling on the Pentagon's flagship AI targeting program and extends access to all military services, the Army said in a contract announcement.
note: A large expansion of a flagship government contract is bullish; 'AI' here is a generic word.

title: Navy picks Boeing for F/A-XX next-generation carrier fighter, passing over Northrop
body: Boeing's defense unit will develop the sixth-generation jet under a contract potentially worth more than $40 billion over the program's life; Northrop Grumman, the only other bidder, said it was reviewing the decision and considering a protest.
note: Boeing wins a multi-decade fighter program, and the losing bidder Northrop misses out on it.

title: Peloton CEO steps down after 20 months; CFO named interim chief
body: Peloton Interactive said its chief executive resigned effective immediately to pursue other opportunities and that the board had begun a search for a successor, without giving further explanation.
note: A sudden, unexplained CEO exit at a turnaround company is bearish.

title: Affirm to join S&P 500, replacing Hasbro
body: S&P Dow Jones Indices said Affirm Holdings will be added to the S&P 500 prior to the open on Monday, Oct. 19, while Hasbro will move to the S&P MidCap 400, prompting index funds to rebalance holdings in both stocks.
note: Index inclusion brings forced buying for Affirm and the deletion brings forced selling for Hasbro; the S&P 500 fund itself is not the subject.

title: Abbott recalls some FreeStyle Libre 3 sensors; FDA labels it most serious type
body: Abbott Laboratories said certain sensor lots could deliver falsely high glucose readings and has received reports of seven serious injuries; analysts said rival DexCom could gain share with prescribers while the issue is resolved.
note: A Class I recall hurts Abbott, and its direct glucose-monitor rival is the likely share gainer.

title: Cloudflare outage knocks websites offline for second time in a month
body: Thousands of sites, including some Shopify merchant storefronts and major news outlets, returned errors for about two hours on Thursday before Cloudflare said it had rolled back a faulty configuration change.
note: A repeat outage raises reliability concerns for Cloudflare; Shopify storefronts are only collateral examples.

title: Hilton Grand Vacations discloses ransomware attack, some systems offline
body: The timeshare operator, spun off from Hilton Worldwide in 2017, said in an 8-K filing that it detected unauthorized access to parts of its network and could not yet estimate the financial impact.
note: A ransomware attack is bearish for HGV; Hilton Worldwide is mentioned only as historical background.

title: Canadian autoworkers strike Stellantis plants in Windsor and Brampton
body: About 7,800 Unifor members walked off the job at 12:01 a.m. Thursday after talks on a new three-year agreement broke down, halting minivan production in Ontario, the union said.
note: A strike that halts production is bearish for the automaker.

title: New Fortress Energy skips bond coupon, enters 30-day grace period
body: The LNG company said it would not make a $112 million interest payment due Oct. 1 on its 2029 notes while it negotiates with an ad hoc group of creditors, and that it has retained restructuring advisers.
note: A missed coupon plus hiring restructuring advisers signals rising bankruptcy risk for equity holders.

title: Oil surges after drone strike on Saudi processing hub; airline stocks slide
body: Brent crude jumped 7% to above $95 a barrel after Saudi Aramco said a drone attack forced it to halt part of its Abqaiq operations; Exxon Mobil and Chevron rose in premarket trading, while Delta Air Lines and United Airlines fell on fuel-cost concerns.
note: An oil supply shock helps oil producers and raises fuel costs for airlines.

title: Fed delivers surprise half-point cut, signals further easing
body: The Federal Reserve lowered its benchmark rate by 50 basis points to a 3.00%-3.25% range, against expectations for a quarter-point move; the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust and the rate-sensitive iShares Russell 2000 ETF jumped in the minutes after the statement.
note: A larger-than-expected rate cut is bullish for broad equities, especially rate-sensitive small caps.

title: U.S. core inflation runs hotter than expected in September, Nasdaq futures slide
body: Core CPI rose 0.5% month on month, versus 0.3% forecast, pushing the 10-year Treasury yield up 14 basis points and sending futures tied to the Nasdaq-100, tracked by the Invesco QQQ Trust, down 1.2% before the open.
note: A hot inflation print lifts yields and hurts long-duration tech, which is bearish for QQQ.

title: Here's why Celsius Holdings stock soared 14% last week
body: Shares of the energy-drink maker rallied after PepsiCo said it would widen distribution of the Alani Nu brand into its convenience-store network; the stock has since given back part of the gain.
note: This recaps a move that already happened, and PepsiCo is only background to the story.

title: 3 Dividend Stocks to Buy Now and Hold Forever
body: Coca-Cola, Altria and Verizon each yield more than 3% and have raised their payouts for decades, making them dependable choices for income-focused investors, in our view.
note: An evergreen opinion listicle has no new information; 'Now' is not ServiceNow.

title: Stocks making the biggest moves midday: Nike, Carnival, Oracle and more
body: Nike slid 7% after pulling its annual guidance, Carnival gained 5% on record wave-season bookings, and Oracle added 3% after Jefferies lifted its price target to $400.
note: A roundup of moves already made gives no fresh catalyst; Jefferies is the broker and 'price target' is not Target.

title: UNH INVESTOR ALERT: Halvorsen & Pike LLP Investigates Claims on Behalf of UnitedHealth Group Shareholders
body: NEW YORK, Oct. 8, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Halvorsen & Pike LLP announces that it is investigating potential securities claims on behalf of shareholders of UnitedHealth Group Incorporated (NYSE: UNH). Investors who purchased shares are encouraged to contact the firm.
note: A boilerplate law-firm solicitation follows earlier moves and is not new information.

title: Class Action Filed Against Hims & Hers Health, Inc. (HIMS) - Lead Plaintiff Deadline December 7, 2026
body: Brandt Kessler LLP reminds investors that a securities class action lawsuit has been filed on behalf of purchasers of Hims & Hers Health common stock between February 24 and July 14, 2026. No class has yet been certified.
note: A routine reminder of a lead-plaintiff deadline is noise, not news.

title: hearing $LCID gets taken private by the Saudis before year end. no link, just what a buddy at a fund told me. we'll see
note: An unsourced social-media rumour is not credible enough to trade on.

title: Wayfair says it is not exploring a sale, pushing back on media report
body: The online home-goods retailer said it has not engaged advisers and is not in talks with any potential buyer, a day after a report that it was weighing strategic options sent the shares up 11%.
note: The denial removes the takeover premium that the earlier report added.

title: The Coca-Cola Company to Present at Barclays Global Consumer Staples Conference
body: ATLANTA, Oct. 8, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The Coca-Cola Company (NYSE: KO) will participate in a fireside chat at the Barclays Global Consumer Staples Conference on Nov. 18. A live audio webcast will be available on the company's investor relations website.
note: A conference appearance notice is routine; Barclays is only the conference host.

title: Microsoft to report fiscal first-quarter 2027 results on Oct. 28
body: REDMOND, Wash. -- Microsoft Corp. will publish fiscal year 2027 first-quarter financial results after the close of the market on Wednesday, Oct. 28, 2026, followed by a conference call with investors at 2:30 p.m. Pacific time.
note: An earnings-date announcement carries no directional information.

title: CrowdStrike to acquire identity-security startup for about $260 million
body: The cybersecurity company said the cash deal for the privately held firm, which has about 90 employees, will not affect its fiscal 2027 financial guidance and is expected to close in the fourth quarter.
note: A tuck-in deal that is immaterial to guidance is not a catalyst.

title: Why Unity Software stock rocketed 40% in September
body: Investors cheered signs that Unity's Vector advertising platform is winning share from AppLovin's Axon engine, although the stock has pulled back modestly so far in October.
note: This looks back at last month's move; AppLovin and 'Axon' (its ad engine, not Axon Enterprise) are only context.

title: Is Nvidia stock a buy ahead of its November earnings report?
body: Shares are up about 35% this year and trade at roughly 32 times forward earnings; data-center demand remains strong and rival AMD has yet to make a meaningful dent, but expectations are high.
note: An opinion piece with no new facts is neutral; AMD is a passing comparison.

title: Look, Costco is the kind of stock you just keep buying on every pullback, I don't care that it's fifty times earnings, membership renewals are the whole story.
note: Generic TV commentary with no news is neutral.

title: Visa Declares Quarterly Cash Dividend
body: SAN FRANCISCO--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Visa Inc. (NYSE: V) today announced that its board of directors declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.67 per share of class A common stock, payable on Dec. 1, 2026, to all holders of record as of Nov. 10, 2026.
note: The quarterly dividend is unchanged and routine.

title: Ford's U.S. sales rise 3% in third quarter, roughly in line with market
body: Ford Motor said it sold about 512,000 vehicles in the United States in the July-September period, with hybrid sales up 18% and electric-vehicle sales down 9%, broadly matching industry trends reported by rivals.
note: Quarterly sales in line with the industry give no surprise.

title: Lululemon suffers worst day in two years after guidance cut
body: Lululemon athletica shares closed down 18% on Friday, a day after the yoga-wear maker lowered its annual sales and profit forecasts, citing softer U.S. traffic and tariff costs.
note: This recaps a guidance cut that is already priced in.

title: $TSLA holding the 50-day like a champ today. not adding, not trimming, just watching
note: Chart chatter with no news is neutral.

title: Meta director sells $4.2 million of stock under prearranged trading plan, filing shows
body: The sale was executed under a Rule 10b5-1 plan adopted in May, according to a Form 4 filed with the SEC; the director still holds more than 40,000 Meta Platforms shares.
note: A small sale under a preplanned 10b5-1 plan is routine.

title: Evercore hires Morgan Stanley veteran to co-lead technology M&A
body: The banker, who spent 17 years at Morgan Stanley advising semiconductor and software clients, will join Evercore as a senior managing director in San Francisco in January.
note: A single senior hire is routine for Evercore; Morgan Stanley is only the banker's former employer.

title: Global PC shipments rise 7% in third quarter as AI laptops drive upgrades, Gartner says
body: Lenovo kept the top spot with a 26% share, while HP Inc. and Dell Technologies each grew shipments by a mid-single-digit percentage, according to preliminary data from the research firm.
note: Third-party shipment data in line with trend barely moves the OEMs; Gartner is only the data source.

title: Pfizer in advanced talks to acquire Summit Therapeutics, sources say
body: Pfizer is in advanced discussions to buy the biotech, whose lung-cancer drug ivonescimab has rivaled Merck's Keytruda in trials, in a deal that could be announced within weeks, according to people familiar with the matter.
note: A credible report of advanced talks lifts the target, the buyer impact is modest, and Merck is only a drug comparison.

title: Goldman Sachs reiterates buy on Apple, keeps $280 target ahead of results
body: The bank said sell-through checks on the latest iPhone lineup are tracking in line with its estimates and left its forecasts unchanged ahead of Apple's fiscal fourth-quarter report later this month.
note: A reiterated rating with unchanged estimates is not new information.

title: TSMC September revenue jumps 38% as AI chip demand stays red-hot
body: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co, the main contract chipmaker for Apple and Nvidia, said on Friday that September revenue rose to NT$342 billion, taking third-quarter sales above the top end of its guidance range.
note: Monthly sales put the quarter above guidance, which is bullish for TSMC; Apple and Nvidia are mentioned only as customers.

title: Texas Instruments forecasts weak fourth quarter as industrial recovery stalls
body: TI expects December-quarter revenue of $4.20 billion to $4.55 billion and EPS of $1.13 to $1.37, both below Wall Street estimates of $4.62 billion and $1.42, as automotive and industrial customers keep working down inventories.
note: Guidance below consensus on both revenue and EPS is bearish.

title: JPMorgan profit tops estimates as dealmaking and trading surge
body: JPMorgan Chase earned $5.12 a share in the third quarter, beating the $4.83 consensus, as investment-banking fees climbed 31% and markets revenue hit a record; the bank also raised its full-year net interest income outlook.
note: An EPS beat plus a higher NII outlook is bullish.

title: Wells Fargo lowers net interest income outlook after third-quarter miss
body: Wells Fargo reported EPS of $1.49 versus $1.58 expected and now sees full-year net interest income roughly flat, compared with prior guidance for growth of 1% to 3%, as deposit costs rose faster than anticipated.
note: An EPS miss and a cut to NII guidance are bearish.

title: Bernstein swaps chip calls: upgrades AMD to outperform, cuts Intel to underperform
body: The firm said AMD's MI450 accelerator ramp gives it a credible second-source position in AI data centers, while Intel faces another year of foundry losses and server share erosion.
note: One note carries opposite rating changes, an upgrade for AMD and a downgrade for Intel.

title: Diamondback Energy to buy Permian Resources in $28 billion all-stock deal
body: Permian Resources holders will receive 0.118 Diamondback share for each share they own, a 22% premium to Tuesday's close; Diamondback said the deal would be dilutive to free cash flow per share in 2027 before synergies.
note: The target gets a premium, while the buyer issues stock in a deal it says is dilutive.

title: Apple weighs Intel's 18A process for some entry-level Mac chips - report
body: Apple has held early talks with Intel about manufacturing a portion of its lower-end M-series processors, which are currently produced solely by TSMC, according to people familiar with the matter; no agreement has been reached.
note: A marquee foundry customer would validate Intel; the effect on Apple is immaterial, and the volume TSMC could lose is small and unconfirmed.

title: Amazon to open pharmacy counters in 100 Whole Foods stores, stepping up challenge to CVS
body: Amazon said the counters will offer same-day prescription pickup for Prime members starting in January, expanding its push into retail pharmacy, where CVS Health operates about 9,000 locations.
note: The move is immaterial for Amazon but raises the competitive threat to CVS's retail pharmacy business.

title: Lilly's weight-loss pill beats Novo's oral Wegovy in head-to-head trial
body: Patients taking the highest dose of Eli Lilly's orforglipron lost 13.1% of their body weight after 72 weeks, compared with 9.8% for Novo Nordisk's oral semaglutide, with similar discontinuation rates due to side effects.
note: A head-to-head win helps Lilly and hurts Novo's competing pill.

title: CoreWeave Signs $19.4 Billion Multi-Year AI Infrastructure Agreement with Microsoft
body: LIVINGSTON, N.J., Oct. 8, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- CoreWeave, Inc. (Nasdaq: CRWV) today announced an expanded agreement to provide Microsoft with dedicated GPU capacity through 2031, lifting CoreWeave's contracted revenue backlog to more than $70 billion.
note: A large backlog addition is bullish for CoreWeave, while it is a routine capacity purchase for Microsoft.

title: Walmart taps FedEx for nationwide last-mile delivery, shifting volume from UPS
body: Under the multiyear agreement, FedEx Ground will handle a majority of Walmart's e-commerce parcels that are not delivered by its own fleet, a business UPS had largely carried; UPS said it expects the change to reduce 2027 volume by a low-single-digit percentage.
note: FedEx wins the volume UPS loses, and the change is operationally minor for Walmart.

title: Arm to sell its own data-center processor, with Meta as first customer
body: Arm Holdings said it will begin shipping a 136-core server chip designed in-house next year, a shift from its traditional licensing model that it expects to add more than $2 billion in annual revenue by fiscal 2029.
note: A new multibillion-dollar revenue stream is bullish for Arm, while Meta is only the launch customer.

title: FDA cracks down on compounded semaglutide sold by telehealth firms
body: The agency warned telehealth companies that marketing compounded versions of Wegovy as equivalent to the approved drug violates federal law and said it would step up enforcement, a boost for Novo Nordisk and a blow to Hims & Hers Health.
note: Enforcement threatens Hims' compounded GLP-1 business and protects Novo's branded sales.

title: Unilever agrees to buy e.l.f. Beauty for $8.4 billion
body: Unilever will pay $142 per share in cash for the fast-growing U.S. cosmetics brand, a 34% premium to Wednesday's close, as the London-based consumer goods group doubles down on prestige beauty.
note: The target trades up toward the cash price, and the deal is small relative to the buyer.

title: ASML third-quarter bookings smash forecasts on AI-driven EUV demand
body: VELDHOVEN, Netherlands -- ASML said net bookings rose to 7.1 billion euros in the July-September period, well above the 5.2 billion euros analysts had expected, and confirmed that it expects 2027 sales to grow.
note: Orders far above consensus are the key metric for ASML and are bullish.

title: Verizon cuts unlimited plan prices up to $15 a line, stoking price-war fears
body: The carrier's new pricing undercuts rival plans from AT&T and T-Mobile US, and analysts said both competitors would likely be forced to respond, pressuring wireless margins across the industry.
note: Price cuts compress Verizon's margins and threaten a sector-wide price war.

title: SAP shares slide in Frankfurt as cloud backlog growth slows
body: The Walldorf-based software group said current cloud backlog grew 23% at constant currencies in the third quarter, below the 26% analysts had pencilled in, and narrowed its cloud revenue outlook to the lower half of its range.
note: A backlog miss and a lower cloud outlook are bearish, and the ADR follows the Frankfurt decline.

title: NIO deliveries hit record in September, up 95% year on year
body: The Shanghai-based electric-vehicle maker said it delivered 41,250 vehicles last month, beating its own guidance, helped by strong demand for its lower-priced Onvo and Firefly brands.
note: Record deliveries above guidance are bullish.

title: Alibaba jumps in Hong Kong after it lifts AI spending plan and unveils new Qwen model
body: Shares of Alibaba Group rose as much as 7% in Hong Kong on Thursday after the company said it would boost cloud and AI infrastructure investment beyond the 380 billion yuan it pledged last year.
note: The Hong Kong rally on the news should carry into the U.S. ADR at the open.

title: Brazil's government presses Petrobras to cut diesel prices ahead of runoff vote
body: Petrobras said it would reduce wholesale diesel prices by 6% starting Saturday, a move analysts at local brokerages said leaves the state-controlled oil company selling below import parity for the first time in a year.
note: Politically driven price cuts below import parity hurt Petrobras margins and governance perception.

title: HSBC third-quarter profit misses as Hong Kong property charges climb
body: HSBC Holdings reported pretax profit of $7.4 billion, below the $8.3 billion analysts expected, after expected credit losses on Hong Kong commercial real estate more than doubled; the bank kept its 2026 return target.
note: A profit miss driven by rising credit losses is bearish.

title: Germany orders more Patriot air-defence systems from RTX in 4.6 billion euro deal
body: Berlin's procurement agency signed a contract for eight additional Patriot fire units built by RTX's Raytheon business, the defence ministry said, the latest in a string of European orders as NATO members boost air defences.
note: A large new international order is bullish for RTX.

title: AeroVironment awarded $990 million Army contract for Switchblade loitering munitions
body: The five-year indefinite-delivery contract is the largest in the company's history and covers both the Switchblade 300 and 600 variants, AeroVironment said.
note: A record contract that is large relative to the company's size is bullish.

title: Lockheed Martin to take $1.6 billion charge on classified aeronautics program
body: The defense contractor said in a filing that it will record the pre-tax loss in the third quarter after a review found higher-than-expected costs to complete a fixed-price development contract, and that additional charges are possible.
note: A large program charge with possible further charges is bearish.

title: Humana's Medicare Advantage star ratings drop, putting 2027 bonus payments at risk
body: About 25% of Humana's members are enrolled in plans rated four stars or above for 2027, down from roughly 40% this year, according to CMS data released Thursday, which could cost the insurer billions in quality bonus payments.
note: Lower star ratings reduce bonus revenue, which is bearish for Humana.

title: Bitcoin falls below $90,000 after $1.2 billion hack at Asian exchange; crypto stocks drop
body: The cryptocurrency slid 8% overnight, pulling down shares of bitcoin-heavy Strategy, exchange operator Coinbase and miner MARA Holdings in premarket trading.
note: A sharp bitcoin drop after a hack weighs on crypto-linked equities.

title: Robinhood September Operating Data: Funded Customers Reach 28.1 Million; Equity Notional Volumes Up 41% Year-over-Year
body: MENLO PARK, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Robinhood Markets, Inc. today reported monthly operating data, including total platform assets of $345 billion, up 6% from August, and net deposits of $6.9 billion, an annualized growth rate of 25%.
note: Strong asset, deposit and volume growth in the monthly metrics is bullish.

title: UBS downgrades Ferrari to neutral, sees order-book slowdown in 2027
body: The Swiss bank cut its price target on the Maranello-based carmaker to $410 from $520, saying waiting lists for core models have shortened and the electric Elettrica is unlikely to offset weaker demand in the U.S.
note: The downgrade with a sharply lower target is bearish for Ferrari; UBS is only the broker.

title: Jefferies raises Celsius price target to $70, reiterates buy after channel checks
body: Analysts said scanner data show Celsius and Alani Nu gaining share in convenience stores for a fourth straight month, supporting upside to third-quarter revenue estimates.
note: A higher price target backed by positive scanner data is bullish; Jefferies is the broker.

title: Ameriprise completes acquisition of $3 billion Midwest wealth management firm
body: Ameriprise Financial said it closed the previously announced purchase of the independent advisory practice, which will add about 40 advisers; terms were not disclosed and the deal is not material to earnings.
note: The closing of a small, previously announced deal is not material.

title: Costco September comparable sales rise 7.2%, topping estimates
body: Excluding gasoline and foreign exchange, U.S. comparable sales increased 7.6%, ahead of the 6.1% analysts had expected, while e-commerce sales jumped 19%.
note: Monthly comparable sales above consensus are bullish.

title: Boeing shares pretty much flat this morning as everyone waits on that machinists' contract vote, results expected after the close.
note: The line describes a flat stock awaiting an event and contains no new information.

title: PepsiCo Q3 EPS $2.39 vs $2.26 est; revenue tops forecasts, reaffirms full-year outlook
body: Organic revenue grew 3.8% versus the 2.5% expected, as price increases offset slightly lower volumes in North American snacks and beverages.
note: Beats on EPS and organic growth are bullish.

title: Domino's U.S. same-store sales jump 5.1%, far ahead of expectations
body: The pizza chain's third-quarter U.S. comps beat the 2.4% consensus, helped by value promotions and growth on third-party delivery apps, while rival Pizza Hut, owned by Yum Brands, has struggled to win back customers.
note: A large comp beat is bullish for Domino's; Yum is only background context.

title: Norwegian Cruise Line cuts 2026 yield forecast; finance chief to depart
body: Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings now expects net yields to rise about 1.5% this year, versus prior guidance of 2.5% to 3%, citing heavier promotional activity on Caribbean itineraries.
note: A yield guidance cut plus a CFO departure is bearish.

title: Breaking news on General Motors right now: the company raising its full-year adjusted EBIT guidance to 13 to 14.5 billion and adding six billion to the buyback.
note: Higher guidance plus a bigger buyback is bullish.

title: XPeng shares slump in Hong Kong after weak fourth-quarter delivery outlook
body: The Guangzhou-based EV maker guided deliveries of 115,000 to 120,000 vehicles for the October-December quarter, well short of the roughly 140,000 analysts had forecast, citing intensifying price competition.
note: Delivery guidance well below forecasts is bearish, and the ADR follows Hong Kong.

title: JetBlue warns of wider fourth-quarter loss as engine inspections ground more jets
body: JetBlue Airways now expects an average of 11 aircraft out of service due to Pratt & Whitney geared turbofan inspections, up from eight previously, and said unit revenue would fall more than it had forecast.
note: A profit warning is bearish for JetBlue; the Pratt engine issue is a known background matter for RTX.

title: Vistra signs 20-year deal to supply Amazon data centers with nuclear power from Comanche Peak
body: The agreement covers 1,200 megawatts from the Texas plant and is expected to add about $0.80 to annual adjusted earnings per share once fully ramped, Vistra said.
note: A long-term, accretive power contract is bullish for Vistra and routine procurement for Amazon.

title: U.S. sets steep duties on solar cells from India, Laos and Indonesia
body: The Commerce Department's preliminary antidumping rates of up to 214% favour domestic manufacturers such as First Solar but will raise equipment costs for residential installers like Sunrun, analysts said.
note: Import duties protect the U.S. module maker and raise input costs for the installer; the India ETF is not the subject.

title: FDA declines to approve Moderna's combination flu-COVID vaccine
body: Moderna said it received a complete response letter requesting additional efficacy data in adults aged 50 to 64, pushing a potential launch beyond the 2027-2028 respiratory season.
note: A complete response letter that delays the launch is bearish.

title: Viking Therapeutics' obesity shot meets main goal in late-stage trial
body: Patients given the highest dose of VK2735 lost an average of 16.4% of body weight after 78 weeks versus 2.1% on placebo in the Phase 3 VANQUISH-1 study, with discontinuations due to side effects below 6%.
note: Positive Phase 3 data with good tolerability is bullish for a single-asset biotech.

title: Intuitive Surgical lifts 2026 procedure growth outlook after strong third quarter
body: Worldwide da Vinci procedures grew about 19% in the quarter, ahead of the 16% analysts had modeled, and the company raised its full-year growth forecast to 18%-19% from 15.5%-17%.
note: Procedure growth above estimates and a raised outlook are bullish.

title: Medical Properties Trust slashes dividend by half after hospital tenant files for Chapter 11

body: Posted on X by Robinhood's CEO.
note: A new large buyback announced by the CEO is a positive capital-return signal.

title: Today I'm sending a letter to the FTC demanding they block Live Nation's latest venue acquisition. Ticket prices are out of control and families are paying the price.
body: Posted on X by a U.S. Senator.
note: A single lawmaker's letter has no legal force and is routine political noise.

title: Effective today, the Department is terminating $900 million in IT services contracts held by Leidos that were wasteful and duplicative. We will do this work in-house for a fraction of the cost.
body: Posted on X by the U.S. Secretary of Defense.
note: Leidos loses $900M in government contracts; 'IT services' does not refer to Gartner.

title: Heads up to our US subscribers: starting next month Spotify Premium Individual moves to $12.99. We've added a lot over the past two years and we think it's still the best value in audio.
body: Posted on X by Spotify's co-CEO.
note: A U.S. price increase lifts revenue per user, and investors usually reward it.

title: Tesla Robotaxi expands to 10 more US cities next month, no safety monitor in the car. Exponential from here.
body: Posted on X by Tesla's CEO.
note: The CEO announced a faster, unsupervised robotaxi rollout, which feeds the stock's main bull thesis.

title: Heads up: I'll be selling ~2% of my COIN shares over the next 12 months under a 10b5-1 plan to fund my science philanthropy. Not going anywhere, more bullish on crypto than ever.
body: Posted on X by Coinbase's CEO.
note: A small, pre-scheduled 10b5-1 sale for philanthropy says nothing about the company's fundamentals.

title: Congratulations to Caterpillar on opening another great American factory in Texas. MADE IN THE USA!
body: Posted on Truth Social by the U.S. President.
note: Political praise for an already-announced plant opening is not news.

title: Novo Nordisk charges Americans ten times what it charges Danes for Ozempic. If they don't fix it within 30 days, we will use every tool we have, including tariffs on their products.
body: Posted on X by the U.S. Health Secretary.
note: A specific deadline and tariff threat from a cabinet official raises U.S. pricing risk for Novo.

title: XPeng delivered 48,112 vehicles in September, a new monthly record and up 95% year over year. Thank you to every customer who chose us. Next stop: 60,000.
body: Posted on Weibo by XPeng's CEO.
note: Record deliveries and near-doubling year-over-year growth are a positive data point.

title: Wells Fargo has spent years ripping off its customers. Now it wants Washington to loosen the rules? Not on my watch.
body: Posted on X by a U.S. Senator.
note: A familiar lawmaker attack with no regulatory action attached does not move the stock.

title: Delta and Joby will launch electric air taxi service between JFK and Manhattan in spring 2027, with Delta SkyMiles members booking seats right in the Delta app.
body: Posted on LinkedIn by Delta's CEO.
note: A firm launch date with a major airline partner is a catalyst for small-cap Joby but immaterial for Delta.
